title: Authenticate European Star Cross indirect records
platforms: European ROM; retained Wine evidence and protected static source plan
changes: Authenticate three Star Cross indirect records and their separately owned root and original caller.
validation: Protected unit 8evjfzvi verifies three eight-byte records, 21 sampled unowned bytes, count three, original caller and the existing indirect-record consumer.
limitations: Static code and sampled addresses do not establish exact scene PCs, all consumers or guest pointer/count domains. Runtime integration, other scenes, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance comparison was made.
